no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was convened to discuss this application. It was judged that the data submitted were adequate to determine whether the risk/benefit relationship was favorable for canakinumab in the treatment of CAPS. Furthermore there were no serious issues in dispute with respect to efficacy or safety and canakinumab is third in class overall and second in class for CAPS.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the original BLA 125319 approval of Ilaris (canakinumab) for CAPS. The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Division Director/Office memo) all state the meeting was deemed unnecessary because canakinumab was the third IL-1 blocking agent approved (second for CAPS), the data clearly established efficacy, and there were no surprising or disputed safety or efficacy issues. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
